IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: Brightline private deployment - control-plane heartbeat missing from on-prem agent (vpc-ble-3). PagerDuty incident: PD-45213. Page fired to #eng-oncall and oncall rotation.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Alert details: agent-heartbeat-missed x20 within 5m, src=agent-broker, dest=control-plane-br-1, severity=high. Auto-escalation in 5m if not acked.
Mike H.: acked on PagerDuty. I'll take first touch.
Jules R.: thx mike. can you confirm whether this is a connectivity issue (vpn/tunnel) or agent process crash?
Mike H.: checking cloudwatch for control-plane in BR region and asking customer for VPN status.
Mike H.: quick checks: control-plane pods show healthy in console but metrics show 0 heartbeats from agent id agent-br-3. Trying to reach agent over customer VPC.
Leah S.: good call — could be route table or firewall. did we see any fw change alerts from config-monitor?
Mike H.: config-monitor shows no recent changes. Attempting TCP connect to agent endpoint via customer VPC peering IP (10.240.12.45:9000)
Leah S.: ping? run a traceroute from our bastion in their VPC region.
Mike H.: traceroute shows stops at their border gateway. suspect tunnel drop.
Customer SRE (Brightline): We're seeing degraded connectivity around 08:13 UTC, and an automated failover kicked in for some subnets. Investigating with our network team.
Jules R.: noted customer sees it too. Mike, can you pull last agent logs before heartbeat stopped?
Mike H.: grabbing logs via control plane log collection:```
2026-03-14T08:12:02Z DEBUG agent: heartbeat sent seq=1023
2026-03-14T08:12:07Z WARN conn: transient failure writing to socket: EPIPE
2026-03-14T08:12:10Z ERROR agent: lost control-plane ack, retrying
2026-03-14T08:12:15Z CRITICAL agent: heartbeat failed, shutting down kv-cache
```
Jules R.: CRITICAL line suggests TCP resets. could be peer firewall or mtu. ask customer to check their appliance logs for TCP RSTs.
Customer SRE (Brightline): their edge appliance shows BGP flaps and then a reboot around 08:12:20 UTC. Network team says they're still diagnosing.
IncidentBot: Note: automatic mitigation policy suggests temporary fallback to hosted control plane proxy for impacted requests. Would you like to trigger? (reply with 'fallback now' to execute).
Leah S.: we should only fallback if customer approves — it changes egress path and has implications for data residency. Contacting account rep.
Mike H.: paging account rep now. cc @oncall-team. Meanwhile, I can open a temporary tunnel from our transit VPC to their subnet to confirm traffic. If customer approves, we can flip routing.
Jules R.: also prepare runbook steps. add checklist: 1) confirm customer approval 2) create transit tunnel 3) update route table 4) monitor heartbeats and latency 5) rollback plan.
Mike H.: creating transit tunnel test now (low-impact). Commands:```
aws ec2 create-vpn-connection --customer-gateway-id cgw-08abc --type ipsec.1 --options StaticRoutesOnly=true
# or for quick test from bastion
ssh -i id_rsa -L 9000:10.240.12.45:9000 bastion@transit
```
PagerDuty: PD-45213 acknowledged by Mike H. Escalation timer paused.
Customer SRE (Brightline): can you confirm what data flows through the control plane? We are worried about PII routing.
Leah S.: control plane only carries agent metadata, heartbeats, and encrypted attestation; customer data plane stays within their VPC. We will not route customer payloads through hosted services. I'll DM more details to security/compliance.
Mike H.: transit tunnel established for test. tcpdump on our side shows SYNs hitting 10.240.12.45 but client sees RSTs. looks like appliance is rejecting connections post-reboot.
Jules R.: ok. push notification to account rep and legal with brief: "Potential VPC connectivity incident for Brightline; control-plane heartbeats failed due to customer edge appliance reboot; preparing non-data fallback pending approvals."
IncidentBot: Reminder: assign incident severity. Proposed severity: S2 (service degraded for single customer on private deployment). Set by Jules R.
Jules R.: I'll own incident commander until handoff. Mike please keep updates every 10m and call in an on-call huddle if customer asks for immediate failover.
Mike H.: update: customer net-team confirms appliance misconfiguration after reboot — firewall policy blocking our control plane IP range. They've applied a temporary allow on the mgmt ACL for 10.240.12.0/24. Heartbeats resumed.
Customer SRE (Brightline): confirming heartbeats are back and agent shows status=connected. We'll coordinate RCA and change window for permanent fix.
Leah S.: great. can you confirm whether any data or requests were impacted? Mike?
Mike H.: logs show 18 failed RPCs during the 3m outage window; retries succeeded once connection resumed. No user payloads processed through our control plane. Impact summary: control-plane telemetry delayed, agent couldn't receive config updates for ~3m, customer reported degraded monitoring.
Jules R.: lowering severity to S3 (partial incident, customer impacted but mitigated). Adding postmortem owner: Customer SRE (Brightline) + Jules R.
Mike H.: moving to close-out. action items: 1) customer to schedule firewall config change for permanent allow 2) we to add a runbook note about appliance reboot causing RSTs 3) add an automated check to verify agent heartbeat count after control-plane rolling restarts.
Customer SRE (Brightline): thanks for the rapid help. We'll follow up with RCA.
IncidentBot: Incident PD-45213 closed by PagerDuty at 1779010245.
Jules R.: thanks team. filing incident report in /incidents and pinging eng-sre for follow-up on runbook. :white_check_mark:
oncall-team: reaction :thumbsup:
